Part - B

Ques 11-1

# Endochondral Ossification

- Ossification is also known as formation of bone.
- Osteoblasts are bone forming cells.

- The Ossification are of two types
(i) Intramembranous
(ii) Endochondral

- Endochondral ossification requires a cartilage model for ossification which is made up of hyaline.

- This is as it includes primary & secondary ossification.

--- Page 4 ---
Steps
(1) Firstly, cartilage model is formed. (Hyaline)
(2) Then this cartilage model forms into bone.
(3) Then primary ossification takes place & develops into the epiphyses. (before birth)
(4) Then secondary ossification takes place & forms the epiphyses. (Takes place after birth)
(5) Then finally the compact bone is formed.

cartilage model
compact bone

Ques. 12.1

# Characteristics of Male Skull

1) Male skull is large as compare to female skull.
2) It is more robust in nature
3) It has square shaped orbits.
4) Eyebrows are more pronounced.
5) In male skull, the shape of mandible is "U".
6) Jawlines are more prominent.
7) Ramus height is more as compared to female skull
8) The overall skull is very hard whereas female skull is smooth.

--- Page 6 ---
a) In male skull, the forehead is slopy and broader.
b) Gonial angle is less in male skull.
c) Mandibulae condyle is more prominent as compared to female skull.

Ques 13.1

1) somatoscopy is the visual examination of a body in which physical features are observed for personal identification.

2) Darwin's Tubercle, ear lobes, supra-orbital ridges and scar or occupational marks are forensically very important in personal identification.

3) supra-orbital ridges are more prominent in males & less prominent in females.

4) scar marks are the marks which are occured from an injury or self harm. they are very helpful in personal identification, they can be unique to the individuals.

5) The occupational marks are the marks which are occured because of the type of profession. like :-

--- Page 8 ---
6) The site workers eat something & many & can have pigments on their teeths.
7) The bangles & iron factory workers may have burnt mark. & many more.
8) Like this we can get to know about the occupation of individuals.
9) Similarly, Darwin's tubercle & ear lobes are also very imp in forensic for personal identification.

Ques.1

The portrait parle or the Bertillon system is, these are given by Alphonse Bertillon. These are they the type of facial reconstruction methods used for the identification of individuals. In these methods the reconstruction of the parts like like eyes, orbits, nose, lips, chin, ear are reconstructed on the basis of the knowledge of these methods.

Whereas, the modern biometric methods are very easy & requires only biometric for the identification of the individuals, which is less time taking & less complicated as compared to the portrait parle / Bertillon system.

--- Page 10 ---
$\rightarrow$ Portrait pale / Bertillon system are very
- complicated
- requires more knowledge.
- takes more time.
- more chances of less accurate.

$\rightarrow$ Whereas, Biometric methods are digital,
- requires less time.
- more accurate.
- very simple & easy.

Ques 15.2

Facial reconstruction is a technique used for personal identification, used in anthropology.

There are many types in which facial reconstruction is possible like:-

(1) Superimposition
The technique in which overlapping occurs. they are putted on one another & then analysing occurs for matching them

(2) 2D Reconstruction.
This is the method in which the photographic superimposition takes place & then examination for personal identifying occurs.

--- Page 12 ---
(3) 3D Reconstruction
This is the method in which reconstruction takes place on a 3-D model & used for examination of personal identity.

(4) Portrait parle / Bertillon system.

(5) Video Superimposition.

Manual
- Requires skilled experts (sketch)
- Non-tool requirements.
- Takes lots of time
- Less accurate

Digital.
- No requirements of sketchers
- Requires very costly tools.
- Requires less time.
- More accurate.

Part-C
Ques 16.1
# Comparative skeleton anatomy of human & non-human bones:

Human
- Short skull
- Chin is present.
- Clavicle is more prominent.
- Bipedal movement
- Bone density is high

Non-Human
- skull is elongated.
- Mostly chin is absent
- Clavicle is absent or less prominent.
- Quadrupedal movement.
- Bone density is less.

--- Page 14 ---
Human
- Bones are inverted for feed bipedal movement
- Small teeth.
- "U" shaped skull.

Non-Human
- Bones are straight for quadripedal movement.
- Bigger Canines.
- "V" shaped skull.

Ques. 20-1

1) Forensic odontology is basically the study related to teeth.

2) There is a very important role of forensic odontology in mass disaster situations.

3) In cases like mass disaster, or burning the teeths are the part of body which does not alter easily. Just that in time the other evidences like hair, fingerprints, DNA can be destroyed.

4) The teeths can be compared with the previous dental records and we can able to identify the victim.

5) With the helps of ones teeth we can able to determine the age of an individual, because as some teeths are erupt at an a

--- Page 16 ---
particular age only. for eg: wisdom teeth = 21 years)

7) we can able to determine the sex of an individual with the help of teeth as female teeths are smaller in comparison to male.

8) Teeth are the only part of the body which can't be altered easily in the mass disaster unlike other evidence like fingerprints, etc.

9) we can able to get bite marks also & will examine & can link it with an individual.

10) INTERPOL consider dental (teeths) are the primary method for identification.

Ques 17.1

# Male & Female skull

1) Male skull is large as compared to female skull.
2) In male skull the orbits are square in shape but in females they are oval in shape.
3) In male skull the supra orbital ridges are more pronounced as compared to female.
4) Mandible of male skull is 'U' shape
5) The ramus height of male skull is more but in females the ramus height is less.
6) In male skull the gonial angle is less than female skull.

--- Page 18 ---
7) The texture of male skull is rugged & hard whereas as females skull have smooth texture.

Eyebrows are more prominent in males.

8) Male skull is more robust.

9) Mandible is short short of female skull but large of male skull

10) Mandibular condyle is more prominent in male skull & less prominent in female skull.

Ques 1
Somatometry
Somato means body
Metry means measurements
Somatometry means the measurements of the body
Head measurement
The measurements of different parts like head, face, nose, ear, height & body weight are taken with very much accuracy so that there will be no mistake in facial reconstruction and can identify individual.
Somatometric measurements are taken with very accuracy so that the report must be clear & justice will be given to right one.

--- Page 20 ---
These measurements are very reliable & needs experts with good knowledge for the measurements with 100% accuracy & give their report & opinion accordingly.

For personal identification this method is very important & accurate too in forensic examination across diverse population.

It is admissible in court too.

Facial superimposition is very useful in forensic science for determining the individuals.
There are many facial superimposition techniques like
- 2D (Photographic)
- 3D (Modeling)
- Video loop superimposition.
- Craniofacial superimposition.
- Portrait parle.
- Bertillon system.

$\rightarrow$ superimposition basically means overlapping (one on another).

$\rightarrow$ They require very skilled & knowledgeable expert
